NONE: B1 something given in exchange for good behaviour or good work, etc.
報答；報償；酬謝；獎賞
B1 an amount of money given to someone who helps the police or who helps to return stolen property to its owner
酬金；賞格；懸賞金
B2 to give someone a reward
報答；報償；獎賞

example: There's a reward for whoever finishes first.
無論誰先完成都會得到一份獎賞。
The rewards of motherhood outweigh the anguish.
做母親得到的回報大於經受的痛苦。
The police offered a reward for any information about the robbery.
警方懸賞徵求有關劫案的任何線索。
The company rewarded him for his years of service with a grand farewell party and several presents.
公司為了答謝他多年爲公司所作的貢獻，為他舉行了一個隆重的歡送會，還贈送了他幾件禮物。
All his hard work was rewarded (= was made worth it) when he saw his book in print.
看到了自己的書付梓出版，他感到一切的艱辛都得到了回報。
formal He rewarded their kindness with hostility and contempt.
他們好心對他，他卻報以敵意和輕蔑。

NONE: › giving a reward, especially by making you feel satisfied that you have done something important or useful, or done something well
值得做的；有意義的

example: Is it a rewarding job?
做這份工作有意義嗎？
Textbook writing can be an intellectually and financially rewarding activity.
編著教科書會是一件很有意義的工作，既可以使人增長知識，又可以獲得經濟上的回報。

NONE: › a card that is given to a customer by a business, used by the business to reward the customer for buying goods or services and to record information about what they buy
（企業給予客戶的）回報卡，獎勵卡

example: He pulled out his grocery rewards card to be scanned.
他抽出他的食品雜貨獎勵卡來掃描。

NONE: › to make a recording go back towards the beginning
倒回（磁帶）；倒（帶）；倒（片）

example: Will you rewind that scene so we can watch it again?
你能倒回到那個場景讓我們再看一遍嗎？
It is now possible to pause and rewind live television.
現在有可能在觀看實況節目時暫停和倒回重放。

NONE: › to put a new system of electric wires into a building or machine
給…重裝電線；給…重新配線

example: You really should have the whole house rewired - the existing wiring isn't safe.
你真的應該把整座房子的線路都更換重鋪——現在用的這些電線不安全。

NONE: › to write something again in different words
修改…的措詞；改寫

example: She reworded sensitive areas of the report so that it wouldn't be so controversial.
她將報告中內容敏感的部分改寫了一下，以免引起太大爭議。

NONE: › to change a speech or a piece of writing in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose
重寫；修訂，修改

example: She reworked her speech for a younger audience.
為了給更年輕的觀衆作演講，她修改了講稿。

NONE: › past simple and past participle of
rewind
B2 to write something such as a book or speech again, in order to improve it or change it because new information is available
重寫；修訂，修改
